design_quote: Crude odds ratios (OR) for EVT, for women vs. men, were pooled across identified studies using random effects inverse-variance weighted meta-analysis.
k_quote: A total of 51 studies (36 non-RCT and 15 RCTs) reporting on sex-specific utilization of EVT were included
reason: Pools a non-randomised sex comparison (women vs men) of EVT use across mixed designs, not a pairwise synthesis of randomised intervention comparisons.
